name: Cần Thơ
registryBasis: The official Cần Thơ Land Registration Office identifies its cadastral registration role and publishes an administrative map page. A city government article describes the city Spatial Planning Platform (SPP) at gis.cantho.gov.vn as providing land-information and land-use-planning lookups, and reports land-information GIS layers and VBDLIS deployment. The advertised SPP is not evidence of anonymous parcel-vector access.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The official city SPP/GIS host and the official land-registration-office subdomain fail direct anonymous DNS resolution from this client, with no HTTP response. The public indexed SPP description confirms land-information and planning lookups, but the indexed ArcGIS Instant Apps item prompts the visitor to sign in. No anonymous feature layer, public parcel schema, or geometry-only service could be directly verified.
scopeLimits: Reviewed official city government SPP description, the city land-registration-office administrative-map page, and indexed ArcGIS portal metadata. The city office map is described as administrative; the SPP is described as land and planning lookup. No map identify, address, legal parcel identifier, owner field, login, or record query was attempted.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the city SPP or a VBDLIS instance provides an anonymous geometry-only map when accessed from a resolving browser/network; whether the advertised layer set contains parcel vectors rather than planning/land-information summaries.

executedQueries.query: Cần Thơ cổng GIS SPP tra cứu thông tin đất đai bản đồ địa chính thửa đất
executedQueries.result: Found the official city SPP description and official city land-registration-office administrative map. Direct map host DNS failure prevented inspection of HTML/JS/schema.

executedQueries.query: Can Tho official land registration office cadastral map parcel GIS
executedQueries.result: Found the city land-registration-office map page and ArcGIS portal references; no anonymous parcel vector route verified.

officialSources.observation: Official Cần Thơ Land Registration Office page titled “Administrative map”; identifies the authoring/updating office and contact. Search/open indexed content was accessible, while direct GET failed DNS resolution.

Official city Party Committee article says the city SPP at gis.cantho.gov.vn supports land-information and land-use-planning lookups; it reports 16 GIS layers from the natural-resources department and VBDLIS operation in 6/9 localities at that time. It does not describe an anonymous parcel-vector endpoint.
Indexed official ArcGIS Instant Apps page displays a sign-in prompt for the item; direct requests to the gis.cantho.gov.vn host could not resolve, so no HTTP status is claimed.
